description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android TV application. The activity extends FragmentActivity and manages UI initialization, including setting the content view and configuring remote control input handling. It contains methods for handling creation and key events, along with UI component setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for Android TV frontend, managing UI and remote control input.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles activity creation, setting layout and initializing UI components.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Processes key events from the TV remote, handling OK, ENTER, and BACK buttons.
